name: rig
description: The lane's resident service: keeps a heartbeat, serves the status board, reads the night's run log.

scripts.test: vitest run && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.verify: tsc --noEmit && python3 -m py_compile mcp-server/config.py mcp-server/tools/watchdog.py scripts/remote_worker.py && pnpm test && node tools/control-rig.mjs map --check
